title: Chocolate Raspberry Brownies
hookLine: United States-inspired chocolate raspberry brownies with 8 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Cream Butter & Sugar Fluffy
steps.instructionTemplate: Heat oven to 180C/160C fan/gas 4. Line a 20 x 30cm baking tray tin with baking parchment. Put the chocolate, butter and sugar in a pan and gently melt, stirring occasionally with a wooden spoon. Remove from the heat. Incorporate {m52860_1}, {m52860_2}, {m52860_3}, and {m52860_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure dark chocolate first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Bake Chocolate Raspberry Brownies & Check Doneness
steps.instructionTemplate: Bake for 30 minutes until the edges turn golden and set while the center remains tender. Test with a toothpick—if it comes out with a few moist crumbs rather than wet batter, it is ready. Incorporate {m52860_5}, {m52860_6}, {m52860_7}, and {m52860_8} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Bake Until Golden & Set
steps.instructionTemplate: Stir the eggs, one by one, into the melted chocolate mixture. Sieve over the flour and cocoa, and stir in. Stir in half the raspberries, scrape into the tray, then scatter over the remaining raspberries. Bake on the middle shelf for 30 mins or, if you prefer a firmer texture, for 5 mins more. Cool before slicing into squares. Store in an airtight container for up to 3 days.
steps.activeMeasureSummary: Salted Butter, Light Brown Soft Sugar
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Add a pinch of flaky sea salt right as it leaves the oven—it makes the dark chocolate flavor taste 2x richer.

steps.title: Cool Completely, Garnish & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: Transfer Chocolate Raspberry Brownies to a wire cooling rack and let it cool for 15–20 minutes so the interior sets cleanly without crumbling. Lift out using the parchment overhang, garnish as desired, and slice into 4 portions.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 45 mins!
